name: Fycheck Ruins
title: Fycheck Ruins
summary: An Empyrean ruin site on the south end of the same 238 m ridge as Fycheck Outpost: two stone bunkers, a meeting hall, three statues, pillar rows and a 19 m Empyrean Stone Tower on the edge of the eastern drop.

landmarks.name: Empyrean Stone Tower
landmarks.note: 0x01001106 on the east rim, broken stones on top (z 254).

site.name: Fycheck Ruins
site.notes: No gazetteer entry; teleport derived on the ridge top 40 m west of the ruins (ground 237.7, nearest drawn object 6.1 m).

shots.standingOrder: Spiral down clockwise around the Empyrean Stone Tower of Fycheck Ruins from 58 m out and 46 m up to 32 m out and 14 m up; stay 6 m from the tall pine on the ridge.
shots.notes: Spiral down onto the ridge-top ruin field: the 19 m Empyrean Stone Tower on the edge of the 100 m eastern drop, the bunkers, the meeting hall and the pillar rows; golden west sun behind the lens.
